{{Top|leg}}
The '''Prime Minister''' was the leader of the [[Tapani Federation]] that governed the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The position was created when the [[Tapani Empire]] fell to a military coup and the Federal era began in 11,139 (Tapani Calendar). During this time the Prime Minister was elected by a [[Tapani Parliament|Parliament]].<ref name="Expanse">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

The person who held this title during the Imperial era led the [[Great Council (Tapani Federation)|Great Council]], the [[Tapani Senate]] and the [[Council of Ten]]. They were elected to the position by majority vote in the Great Council. To achieve the required number of votes in the council, a prospective Prime Minister had to assemble a coalition among its members. Elections were traditionally held once every five years or when there was a radical shift in the balance of power, but the council was theoretically able to call for new elections at any time.<ref name="Expanse" />
